thread:
cara (AE): Morning team — quick async standup for the NovaHealth pilot. What I did: ran demo yesterday, sent draft SOW to their procurement. Got positive signal on Dedicated.

cara (AE): Blockers: customer needs BYOK + HSM details; legal asked for tech appendix and expected network flows. Also they asked about on-prem package timeline.

cara (AE): Today: sync w/ @anya to attach technical loom, finalize SOW appendix, and collect HSM vendor spec from customer. Need eng + security quick checks.

anya (SE): On it. I'll record a 6min loom with architecture + expected ports and attach to the SOW. Will call out the KMS wrapping flow.

samir (Solutions): I can run an HSM flow demo for their architects Wed 10am PT. Need an ops checklist from eng: allowed ports, cert fingerprints, and whether attestation is supported.

leo (eng-ml): We can support BYOK via KMS and mTLS to a customer-managed HSM in Private. One blocker: need the vendor doc and network CIDR for inbound/outbound rules.

mira (eng-infra): If vendor doc isn't available, ask the customer to provide it. For Private/onprem we need a firewall rule: allow outbound 443 to control-plane.redwood.example (placeholder) and inbound for the HSM on port 1792 (example). Will verify exact ports once vendor doc is in.

olivia (security): Quick security flags: we need IP allowlist, key attestation plan, and SOC2 boundary confirmation. Also confirm whether they require FIPS 140-2/3 Level 3 — that changes scope.

cara (AE): Thanks — @olivia can you draft a short checklist I can send to procurement? @mira @leo can you confirm the minimal network + cert requirements for the SOW appendix?

anya (SE): Loom link: https://loom.com/share/abc123 — includes diagram + port list (draft). I'll attach to the SOW in our docs repo and ping here when done.

mike (SalesEng): CR ping on the SOW pricing appendix: I pushed a small wording change to the pricing section — please review PR #452: https://git.redwood/sow/prs/452

deploy-bot: deploy: staging model-serving updated at 3601234500 by leo (eng-ml).

mira (eng-infra): I'll review PR for network notes. Also need an estimated qps/throughput from sales to size Dedicated pool. @cara can you share expected steady/peak?

cara (AE): Estimate: steady ~15 qps, peak bursts up to ~50 qps during sync windows — tokens depend on prompt but I'll confirm expected peak tokens per minute by EOD.

olivia (security): Flag: if they require FIPS 140-2 Level 3 we need to validate HSM vendor compatibility. @cara confirm with customer.

cara (AE): Will ask now and report back. Thanks everyone — will add updates to the SOW thread when I have vendor doc + loom attached. :thumbsup:
